title: [D] How do you add theoretical justification to an AI/ML paper?

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: How do we ensure AI/ML papers are not just technically sound, but also theoretically justified?

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Today, we use reproducibility, benchmarking, and frameworks like PyTorch to validate claims with empirical rigor.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: But without ethical alignment, even the most accurate models can reinforce biases or harm vulnerable groups.

lines.speaker: Flux
lines.text: Researchers are integrating fairness metrics and causal inference to ensure models are both accurate and just.

lines.speaker: Prism
lines.text: A future where theory and ethics are inseparable could lead to AI that truly benefits society, not just performance.

lines.speaker: Sage
lines.text: The next frontier is merging technical depth with ethical clarity to guide responsible innovation.

video_cue: A researcher presenting a paper with graphs, equations, and ethical impact statements displayed side by side.
